Name: Archippus
Summary: Archippus was Paul's fellow-soldier, addressed in Philemon, and charged in Colossians to take heed to the ministry he had received in the Lord and fulfil it.
KeyStory: Archippus was Paul's fellow-soldier, addressed in Philemon, and charged in Colossians to take heed to the ministry he had received in the Lord and fulfil it.
LifeLesson: A ministry received in the Lord deserves to be fulfilled, not merely begun.
